data.name: DarkFactory
data.detailed_description:
Work Together. Bend the Rules. Make Quota!

DarkFactory is an online co-op action game where you must do whatever it takes to meet grueling production quotas—even if it means getting your hands dirty. Producing legitimate goods isn't enough to survive here. You must resort to manufacturing "Illicit Goods," balancing the risk of ruin against the pursuit of efficiency. Making "evil decisions" is part of the job description.

Keep the Factory Running

Production, Logistics, Sales, and... Inspector Management. If you can't coordinate roles effectively, the factory will collapse in an instant. In a situation that changes in real-time, communicate with your team and make split-second decisions to keep the line moving.

Illicit Goods: The Ultimate Boost

Manufacturing "Illicit Goods" dramatically skyrockets your production efficiency. But beware—it’s a gateway to destruction. If an Inspector catches you, massive penalties will make hitting your quota significantly harder. Do you risk it for speed? The choice—and the consequences—are yours.

Endless Cycle of "Labor" and "Strategy"

The game proceeds in two phases:

  • Labor Phase: Process orders and meet the daily quota at all costs.

  • Strategy Phase: Use your earnings to buy items, upgrade equipment, or buff yourself for the next day. The quotas get harder day by day. There is no escape from this cycle.

Master Three Trading Methods

Adapt to the situation using three distinct shipping methods:

  • Standard Trade: The safe and reliable basic route.

  • Emergency Trade: High-volume orders with a strict time limit. Sudden, tense, and high-reward.

  • Shadow Trade: A dangerous deal where you throw goods out the window to a shady dealer lurking in the dark.

"Handle" the Inspector

Inspectors visit regularly. If they find your illegal products, you face heavy fines. Will you hide the evidence? Steal it back from them? Or perhaps... eliminate the Inspector entirely? Your on-the-spot judgment will determine the factory's fate.

Conspire and Cross the Line Together

There is no single right answer. The situation and your team's choices determine everything. DarkFactory offers the unique thrill of "breaking the rules with friends"—a guilty pleasure you can't experience in real life—mixed with the chaos and laughter that only co-op play can provide.
